name: FlowWeft
title: Trace patterns back to their source.
description: A web workspace for network-flow batches, analytical explanations and reproducible provenance.
invariants: Feature schema and input provenance bound
No duplicate counting and no train/test temporal leakage

tasks.title: docs(product): confirm personal use acceptance and demand hypotheses
acceptance: Choose one owned real task, identify current workaround and record measured baseline; public demand remains unvalidated.

tasks.title: chore(toolchain): verify supported versions and lock dependencies
acceptance: Official support/release URLs and verification date exist for each selected dependency; no future or assumed version pin.

tasks.title: chore(app): initialize selected minimal runtime
acceptance: Fresh checkout boots minimal CLI or local UI; do not run legacy Laravel/PostgreSQL bootstrap.
Web entry point is mandatory. W01-W05 supply the tested shell; complete engine obligations before verifying C03.

tasks.title: feat(contracts): freeze typed local and transport contracts
acceptance: Inputs, errors, output, schema versions, timeout and compatibility behavior are typed with positive/negative fixtures.

tasks.title: feat(storage): implement minimal authoritative storage adapter
acceptance: Authority, atomic write boundary and recovery mechanism match selected profile; storage loss test has actionable result.

tasks.title: ci(checks): run actual runtime build and foundational tests
acceptance: Clean-checkout build, formatting and contract/invariant tests pass; plan validation is never reported as application testing.

tasks.title: feat(import): define csv and zeek schema mapping
acceptance: Unknown field meanings and packet-versus-flow mismatch require explicit mapping.

tasks.title: feat(upload): stream bounded private batch uploads
acceptance: Size limit and interrupted uploads do not commit a visible batch.

tasks.title: feat(normalize): normalize addresses time and flow units
acceptance: Original timestamp and units survive; timezone ambiguity remains marked.

tasks.title: feat(identity): compute stable observed flow identifiers
acceptance: Reordered rows and repeated same batch do not double count observations.

tasks.title: feat(quarantine): record invalid row reasons and coverage
acceptance: Report states rejected-row fraction and cannot present partial input as full coverage.

tasks.title: feat(parquet): commit immutable partition manifests
acceptance: Manifest becomes visible only after files durable; orphan temp files are cleaned on restart.

tasks.title: feat(jobs): checkpoint single writer batch processing
acceptance: Crash resumes from safe checkpoint with same final partition hashes.

tasks.title: feat(query): implement bounded duckdb analytical queries
acceptance: Only allowlisted query shapes run with memory/time limits and cancellation.

tasks.title: feat(features): version deterministic feature extraction
acceptance: Identical partition and schema produce identical feature table.

tasks.title: feat(baseline): compute explainable statistical anomalies
acceptance: Every anomaly includes threshold, baseline window and observed measurement.

tasks.title: feat(lineage): bind inference to exact source and detector
acceptance: Missing or mismatched feature schema prevents inference.

tasks.title: feat(labels): record analyst classifications separately
acceptance: Analyst label cannot mutate flow observations or train/test split metadata.

tasks.title: feat(api): expose private batches summaries and findings
acceptance: Pagination and object authorization work; raw SQL and arbitrary paths are not accepted.

tasks.title: feat(ui): guide mapping and show batch coverage
acceptance: User sees units, rejected rows, data age and mapping preview before processing.

tasks.title: feat(ui): render drilldown baseline explanations
acceptance: Anomaly and confirmed attack labels remain distinct in charts and tables.

tasks.title: feat(export): create reproducible report bundles
acceptance: Bundle includes source hashes, mappings, schema, detector version and limitations.

tasks.title: feat(privacy): redact addresses with documented join semantics
acceptance: Export supports pseudonymous stable joins with secret mapping excluded.

tasks.title: feat(retention): expire raw input and derived partitions
acceptance: Retention cannot leave dangling manifests; delete outcome is auditable.

tasks.title: feat(evaluation): add baseline quality and temporal split harness
acceptance: Held-out time/session groups avoid leakage; quality report states class counts and data limitations.

tasks.title: test(recovery): exercise partition corruption and disk pressure
acceptance: Corrupt partition, full disk and process kill do not yield silently successful analysis.

tasks.title: test(security): close abuse and authorization release gaps
acceptance: Run project-specific negative UAT plus XSS/import/auth checks for enabled surfaces; document unsupported attack surface and unresolved findings.

tasks.title: perf(budgets): measure target workload and overload behavior
acceptance: Record hardware, OS, source digest, workload, p50/p95/p99 where meaningful, CPU, RSS, storage growth, cancellation and saturation; lower supported limits if targets fail.

tasks.title: feat(operations): expose health diagnostics and bounded logs
acceptance: Local health/status path identifies storage/job/provider failure; sensitive content is absent from synthetic log sentinel test.

tasks.title: test(recovery): prove personal backup restore and private install
acceptance: Fresh machine/browser install and restore completes project UAT; personal deployment remains private until its relevant safety gates pass.

tasks.title: build(packaging): create versioned installable artifacts
acceptance: Static/CLI/container artifact matches chosen distribution; SBOM, licenses, checksums and provenance truthfully reflect what is built.

tasks.title: feat(web): configure domain tls and isolated public demo
acceptance: Domain/HTTPS/cookies/CSP and private-origin policy are checked; public demo contains synthetic data only and dangerous runtime features are disabled.

tasks.title: test(ux): verify accessibility mobile and update behavior
acceptance: Keyboard/table alternative, 360px through 1440px layouts, empty/error/offline states and N-1 data upgrade fixtures work on documented supported platforms.

tasks.title: docs(release): publish english usage limits and support contract
acceptance: New user completes one documented task; English install/use/privacy/limits/support pages include owner contact supplied by maintainer and actual evidence links.

tasks.title: test(release): exercise signed artifact and clean upgrade paths
acceptance: Install artifact from clean environment; verify signer with independently trusted key/identity; supported upgrade and rollback preserve latest valid data.

tasks.title: docs(beta): record independent pilot feedback and beta gate
acceptance: Target: 5 relevant trials, 3 complete core task and 2 return for real repeat use; if unavailable continue personal release and mark demand unvalidated rather than inventing pilots.

tasks.title: fix(beta): resolve evidence backed pilot blockers
acceptance: Fix observed failures, re-run affected checks, record remaining limitations; if no pilots, use observed personal UAT issues and retain unvalidated market label.

tasks.title: docs(service): freeze retention portability quotas and support policy
acceptance: For public service state data location, deletion/export rules, quotas, expected support and outage behavior; paid billing and SLA are not enabled without separate ADR.

tasks.title: ci(release): verify v1 gate from clean source tree
acceptance: Every mandatory requirement has actual passed evidence; no critical open security/recovery issue; release profile and demand status are explicit.

tasks.title: chore(release): publish v1 artifacts and monitor first use
acceptance: Release only verified profile artifacts, run installed smoke test, record actual version/source digest and follow up support/rollback; never publish fabricated claims.

webTasks.title: Browser workspace and project roadmap
webTasks.acceptance: Responsive workspace, local JSON preview, accessible navigation and filterable forty-task roadmap work.

webTasks.title: Validated runtime and constrained web server
webTasks.acceptance: Configuration fails closed; no engine admission, same-origin paths, health scopes, no-store configuration and path containment are tested.

webTasks.title: Automated build and verification pipeline
webTasks.acceptance: Pinned Actions build the application, run web tests and publish a web-only CI artifact. Remote run result is recorded separately.

webTasks.title: Web release packaging and operator configuration
webTasks.acceptance: Package contains runnable web server, assets, checksums and provenance; TLS proxy and hardened systemd templates are supplied, not deployed.

webTasks.title: Reconcile web delivery with product plans
webTasks.acceptance: All supplied forty product intents and requirements remain traceable. Existing code and protected configuration are preserved.

webTasks.title: FlowWeft engine integration
webTasks.acceptance: Implement the first domain slice from IMPLEMENTATION_BLUEPRINT.md through the browser; return real typed results and failures.

webTasks.title: Private identity and permission boundaries
webTasks.acceptance: Establish project-scoped identity, object authorization, CSRF for cookie mutations, bounded work and redacted audit before enabling a private engine API.

webTasks.title: Observed host deployment and recovery
webTasks.acceptance: Provision an owned domain/TLS and approved private admission, install artifact, observe health, validate persistence/provider recovery and retain measured evidence.
